mainEntity.name: What information should I collect from attendees before building an AI webinar?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ask registrants about their role, experience, goal, current tools, and biggest obstacle, but collect only information needed for the event. Use responses to adjust examples, terminology, demonstration depth, and follow-up—not to assume every attendee has the same business model. Context: Audience-centered presentation guidance recommends identifying what participants know, expect, care about, and may challenge. Run My AI Biz serves varied owners, from aspiring entrepreneurs to established small-business operators. Key factors: - Useful segmentation questions - Consent and privacy notice - Sample size and response quality - Whether answers change the agenda Practical guidance: Include three to five short registration questions and review the results before finalizing the deck. Group answers into themes rather than exposing individual responses. Update the opening example and Q&A plan based on those themes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Collect only information that will change the session: role, AI experience, business goal, current tools, and biggest obstacle. Use three to five short questions, disclose how responses will be used, group answers into themes, and adjust examples, terminology, demonstrations, and Q&A accordingly.
